title: v1 natural barriers
about: Proposed by game/v1-world for David to accept in /lab/map (?fixture=v2). Accepting adds them to the painter's document; Save writes web/data/world-map.json. Each stands until its drop opens the way (lib/game/barriers.ts).

objects.note: Over the carved trail where it climbs from level 2 to 3: the mountain and the Oracle temple wait for v2 (the cleanup).
Village bank of bridge site 0 (draft_from_png.py BRIDGES): planks stacked, stakes and a rope across the bridge head.
Village bank of bridge site 1, facing across the strait along the bridge's line.
Where the path from the village meets the ruins: fallen stones and roots. The ruins open with combat (v3).
